defects: Adds an unnecessary hypothesis `[Monoid M]` on M that is not required in the gold statement — the additive-homomorphism-extensionality fact only depends on the Finsupp additive structure of R[M], not on any monoid structure on M, so gold has no typeclass constraint on M at all

Strengthens the codomain hypothesis from `[AddZeroClass N]` (gold, the minimal requirement for `→+` to make sense) to `[AddMonoid A]` (produced), an unnecessarily stronger constraint that restricts the class of valid codomains
